# dsf-examples

[![CI](https://github.com/Grufoony/dsf-examples/actions/workflows/ci.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/Grufoony/dsf-examples/actions/workflows/ci.yml)

Usage examples for the DynamicalSystemFramework.

**Live demo:** <https://grufoony.github.io/dsf-examples/>, the outputs of every example, regenerated by CI.

## Getting Started
This project uses `uv`. To install requirements:
```shell
uv sync
```
Then run a script from its own folder, e.g. `cd 0_cartography && uv run cartography.py`.

To lint and format with ruff on every commit, install the pre-commit hook once:
```shell
uv run pre-commit install
```

## CI
On every push and pull request, CI lints the code with ruff, runs every example, checks that the
results make sense, and, on `main`, publishes them to GitHub Pages. To do the same locally:
```shell
uv run ruff check . && uv run ruff format --check .
uv run ci/examples.py run     # run all the examples in order
uv run ci/examples.py check   # sanity checks on the results
uv run ci/examples.py site    # build the website in _site/
```
New examples must be added to the `EXAMPLES` list in [ci/examples.py](ci/examples.py).
